children: Lumentum Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ:LITE) showcased a 1060 nm VCSEL die-to-die interconnect with Qualcomm and Corning at ECOC 2026 achieving ~1 Tb/s per mm today and a roadmap to ~4 Tb/s per mm, while director Erman Timurdogan will present on Sept. 23 about scaling 800G and 1.6T silicon photonic transmitters.
: Lumentum (LITE) demoed a 1060 nm VCSEL die-to-die optical interconnect with Qualcomm and Corning at ECOC 2026: 32 Gb/s NRZ channels, ~1 Tb/s per mm today, roadmap to ~4 Tb/s per mm.
Lumentum Director to Present on Silicon Photonics
: Lumentum (LITE) director Erman Timurdogan will present on Sept. 23, 11:00–11:30 a.m., at A2 Auditorium 2 about scaling 800G and 1.6T silicon photonic transmitters.
